constraints.description: All proposals are expected to incorporate mechanisms for assessing and demonstrating progress, including qualitative and quantitative KPIs, benchmarking, and progress monitoring.
When possible, proposals should build on and reuse public results from relevant previous funded actions.
Communicable results should be shared with the European R&D community through the AI-on-demand platform.
Projects selected in this topic should link to the resources offered by the AI Factories, including the Data Labs.
Results may be validated in the Testing and Experiment Facilities and further deployed via the European Digital Innovation Hubs (EDIHs).

This topic implements the co-programmed European Partnership on AI, data, and robotics (ADRA), and all proposals are expected to allocate tasks for cohesion activities with ADRA and the CSA HORIZON-CL4-2025-03-HUMAN-18: GenAI4EU central Hub.
Proposals should also build on or seek collaboration with relevant projects and develop synergies with other relevant International, European, national, or regional initiatives.
Activities are expected to start at TRL 2 and achieve TRL 5 by the end of the project.
Maximum EU contribution per project is EUR 19,000,000; indicative total topic budget is EUR 38,000,000 for an indicative 2 projects.

Participation is limited to legal entities established in EU Member States, Iceland, Norway, and associated countries: Canada, Israel, Republic of Korea, New Zealand, Switzerland, and the United Kingdom. Entities controlled by non-eligible countries may be excluded unless guarantees are provided.

To ensure portfolio coverage, grants will be awarded to applications not only in order of ranking, but also to at least one proposal focusing on each of the three sectors (one in healthcare, one in advanced manufacturing and one in in-vehicle autonomous driving), subject to proposals passing all evaluation thresholds.
Financial support to third parties (FSTP) is provided: maximum EUR 300,000 per grant at stage 2, maximum EUR 2,250,000 per grant at stage 3, and maximum EUR 2,550,000 per third party.
Projects must contribute to the Apply AI strategy.
The submission deadline is 2026-04-15 with a single-stage deadline model; the call opens 2026-01-15.
Maximum project duration is 48 months. This is the standard maximum for large RIA actions under Horizon Europe; the topic text does not explicitly state a duration limit.
